text:
Maia: Heads-up — canary for payments-service stuck at postupgrade job step, deploy-bot shows preflight lock on subchart sync.
Jonah: saw that, preflight job `migrate-2026-03` hasn't completed on 3/5 canary pods. logs show `timed out waiting for DB migration lock`.
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot: Canaries paused: payments-service v2.7.4 -> v2.8.0 (subchart payment-subchart v1.3.0 -> v1.4.0). preflight: migration lock detected.
Maia: quick question — do we want to auto-revert the entire release, or keep canary paused and pin subchart?
Lucy: Prefer manual pin + extend canary window if migration is long-running. Auto-revert could hide a legitimate migration that needs operator attention.
Jonah: agree with Lucy. plan: 1) annotate the release with `release.redwood/hold-reason=preflight-migration` 2) extend canary window +30m (`deploy-bot extend-canary payments-service 30m --reason preflight`) 3) if migration job fails on all canary replicas after extension -> rollback.
SRE Oncall: if we extend, set alert to slice traffic to zero if latency > 1s or error rate > 1% during extension. I'll add a temporary SLO override.
Maia: I'll apply the annotation and run the extend command. Also creating a quick rollback runbook in the thread.
Maia: runbook snippet:
```
# rollback steps (manual)
1. kubectl -n prod rollout undo deployment/payments-service --to-revision=REV_PRECANARY
2. helm rollback payments-release REV_PRECANARY --namespace prod
3. revert any values overrides related to payment-subchart image/tag
4. run smoke tests: curl -f https://payments.prod/internal/health || alert oncall
```
Jonah: add one more: pin subchart to last-known-good digest in values: `payment-subchart.image.digest: sha256:abc123...` so future promotions don't pick up the problematic subchart.
Lucy: I'll prepare the values patch and post it. small patch: `{ payment-subchart: { image: { tag: "1.3.0-rc", digest: "sha256:abc123" } } }`
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot: noting manual hold - canary extension applied by Maia. Will not auto-revert while annotation exists.
Maia: posting release-note blurb (internal): "Canary paused for payments-service v2.8.0 due to migration preflight lock on payment-subchart. Extended canary by 30m for operator investigation. If migration fails across canary replicas, release will be rolled back."
DevEx: please also capture which values were overridden in this run so engineering docs can be updated.
Jonah: done — pushing values patch to staging: `kubectl -n prod patch configmap payments-values --patch-file=payment-subchart-pin.yaml` and will open a PR to track it.
Lucy: if the migration lock keeps failing, we may need to run maintenance migration outside canary then resume. keep me posted.
SRE Oncall: I've set the temporary alert and bumped the escalation to paged if errors spike.
Maia: thanks all — next check in 20m. @Jonah @Lucy please confirm patch applied. :thumbsup:
Jonah: patch applied, PR opened: https://git.redwood/repo/PR-4215
Lucy: patch verified on canary node logs. migration job still trying to acquire lock; operator on call is investigating DB locks.
Maia: updating thread when we have operator update.
Operator: (via DM -> posted here) DB team: found stale lock from prior run, cleared it. re-triggering migration job now.
Maia: re-trigger observed, migration succeeded on 2/5 canary pods, third still pending but progressing.
Deploy Bot: deploy-bot: canary health improving, metrics trending down. Holding note removed after manual confirmation by Maia.
Maia: removing hold annotation and proceeding with normal promotion window. final note to release notes: "hold resolved after DB lock cleared; subchart pinned temporarily during investigation."
Jonah: will follow up with backfill ticket to add migration mutex checks to preflight to prevent this recurrence.
Maia: closing thread once PR merged and release notes updated. :white_check_mark:
